cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(fast_neon_vendor)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
set(SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR "$ENV{SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR}" CACHE PATH "Directory populated by prepare_dependencies.py")
if(NOT SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Run scripts/prepare_dependencies.py DIR and set SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR=DIR")
endif()
set(source "${SCHURVINS_DEPENDENCY_DIR}/fast_neon")
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${source}" rev-parse HEAD OUTPUT_VARIABLE revision OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE RESULT_VARIABLE status)
if(NOT status EQUAL 0 OR NOT revision STREQUAL "4914ed963aba8d2bb476551e186e4b20a206f03d")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "fast_neon source revision differs from dependencies.lock.json")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${source}" status --porcelain OUTPUT_VARIABLE source_changes OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE RESULT_VARIABLE dirty_status)
if(NOT dirty_status EQUAL 0 OR NOT source_changes STREQUAL "")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Locked vendor source is modified: ${source}")
endif()
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
find_package(glog REQUIRED)
set(sources ${source}/src/fast_9.cpp ${source}/src/fast_10.cpp ${source}/src/fast_10_score.cpp ${source}/src/nonmax_3x3.cpp)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm)")
  list(APPEND sources ${source}/src/faster_corner_9_neon.cpp)
else()
  list(APPEND sources ${source}/src/faster_corner_10_sse.cpp)
endif()
add_library(fast SHARED ${sources})
target_compile_features(fast PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
  target_compile_options(fast PRIVATE -mssse3)
endif()
target_include_directories(fast PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${source}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
install(DIRECTORY "${source}/include/" DESTINATION include)
install(TARGETS fast EXPORT export_${PROJECT_NAME} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
ament_export_targets(export_${PROJECT_NAME} HAS_LIBRARY_TARGET)
ament_package()
